subject: Invoice cadence concierge: PO activation & billing-window alignment for CobaltCloud
messages:
From: Jamie Foster <jamie.foster@cobaltcloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@cobaltcloud.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice window vs PO activation for Redwood pilot

Hi Jordan,

Quick intro — I manage vendor ops at CobaltCloud. We're finalizing the PO (4532) for the Redwood pilot and I wanted to confirm how invoice windows map to PO activation. Our AP runs a consolidated weekly remit (invoices cut on Fridays, paid net45), but our procurement team prefers PO activation to align with service start to avoid early billings.

Two asks from our side:
- Can the Redwood billing team accept invoices that match the PO activation date (i.e., invoice effective date = PO start) rather than the invoice upload date?
- If not, are there options for staged acceptance (initial acceptance at PO activation, full acceptance after first deliverable) or a Net-30/Net-45 split to accommodate both teams?

We also have a short onboarding form and the signed PO draft — I'll attach both. Please loop in whoever owns the activation workflow.

Thanks,

Jamie Foster
Vendor Operations | CobaltCloud
jamie.foster@cobaltcloud.com
attachments: Cobalt_Onboard_021.pdf, Cobalt_PO_4532.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Foster <jamie.foster@cobaltcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice window vs PO activation for Redwood pilot

Hi Jamie — thanks for the note and the attachments. Looping in Karthik (finance/procurement) and Marissa (CS/onboarding) so we can confirm the activation <> invoice mapping.

Short answers up front:
- We can accept an "effective invoice date" that matches the PO activation date for billing purposes, provided the invoice metadata includes the PO ID and the documented service start date.
- We support staged acceptance, but need a short mutual action plan to define the deliverables and timing so our billing system can route invoices to the correct ledger.

Karthik — can you confirm whether Net-45 is acceptable if we record an effective invoice date equal to PO start? If not, what edge cases do we need to flag (credit hold, backdating limits, tax stamping)?

Jamie — if you can confirm the PO start date and which team will approve the activation (procurement or project lead), we'll propose the minimal set of fields to include on the invoice so your AP doesn't have to change remit behavior.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
phone: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamie Foster <jamie.foster@cobaltcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice window vs PO activation for Redwood pilot

Thanks — a few implementation notes from finance: 

1) Effective invoice date: We can honor an effective date matching PO activation as long as the invoice file contains:
   - PO number (4532)
   - service start date (YYYY-MM-DD)
   - invoice effective date field explicitly set

2) Net-term split: We can support a hybrid schedule for this pilot: initial invoice (month 0) Net-30, subsequent recurring invoices Net-45. This helps CobaltCloud keep their weekly cut schedule while aligning cashflow. 

3) Controls & edge cases:
   - No backdating beyond 7 days from invoice upload without FP approval.
   - If invoice metadata mismatches PO (amounts or dates), invoice will route to billing dispute desk and may push beyond standard terms.

Action items for the team: 
- Jordan: confirm the PO start date and whether CobaltCloud wants the Net-30 first-pay + Net-45 thereafter pattern.
- Marissa: include the onboarding acceptance checklist for the Service Start (deliverable A) so we can tag invoices against it.

Karthik
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Jamie Foster <jamie.foster@cobaltcloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@cobaltcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice window vs PO activation for Redwood pilot

Thanks Karthik — that hybrid schedule works for us. Confirming: PO 4532 service start = 2028-06-12 (project kickoff). CobaltCloud AP will upload invoices on Friday cycles but will include the fields you outlined. 

Attached: completed onboarding form and final PO (see attachments). Procurement will route the activation approval to our project manager (Alyssa Kim) on 6/12. 

Notes: 
- We prefer the first invoice Net-30 (due 2028-07-12) and subsequent invoices Net-45.
- If there's an automated tag we should include on the PDF metadata, let us know; otherwise we'll add a line item on the invoice: "Effective service start: 2028-06-12; PO: 4532".

Jamie Foster

- 2028-06-12: Project kickoff / PO activation (Alyssa Kim approves)

- Red flags: any invoice with mismatched amount/dates routes to Billing Dispute; backdating beyond 7 days requires finance approval
- Next steps: Jamie to confirm Alyssa Kim's approval email (we will watch for it on 6/12). Jordan to upload MAP to HubSpot + send DocuSign for the small SOW amendment to record the billing cadence.
